Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.label: recruit through a trader
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.description: Ask a visiting trader to spread word of the colony on their travels. Applicants come from the trader's faction and walk in.
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.arrivalLabel: walk in from the edge of the map

Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.label: ask at a settlement
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.description: Send a caravan to a settlement of a friendly or neutral faction and ask there for settlers. The silver is paid from the caravan's goods on arrival; applicants from that faction then walk to the colony. Each settlement can only be asked once in a while.
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.arrivalLabel: walk in from the edge of the map

Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.label: radio broadcast
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.description: Broadcast a call for settlers from a powered comms console ("call for settlers" in its list of contacts), or ask one faction directly from its comms dialog. Applicants walk in. Radio cannot reach the planet from space.
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.arrivalLabel: walk in from the edge of the map

Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.label: orbital comms
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.description: Relay a call for settlers through orbit from a powered comms console, or ask one faction directly from its comms dialog. Applicants drop in by transport pod near the colony, and this also works from space.
Recruitment.RecruitmentMethodDef.arrivalLabel: drop in by transport pod near the colony
